items.unit: % of cost of sales (distribution + administrative expenses, ex-impairment)
items.basis: TI Fluid Systems plc FY2024 (year to 31 Dec 2024): revenue EUR 3,360.3m; gross profit EUR 396.8m, so cost of sales = 3,360.3 - 396.8 = EUR 2,963.5m (aggregator S&P data: 2,964); distribution costs EUR 105.7m; administrative expenses EUR 143.2m of which EUR 21.4m goodwill impairment, so underlying admin EUR 121.8m. SG&A = 105.7 + 121.8 = 227.5. 227.5 / 3,360.3 = 6.77% of revenue; 227.5 / 2,963.5 = 7.68% of cost of sales. Admin alone: 121.8 / 3,360.3 = 3.62% of revenue, 121.8 / 2,963.5 = 4.11% of cost of sales.
items.scope: UK-listed global Tier-1 (fluid lines, fuel tanks); group figures, all regions
items.notes: Read from search-result snippets (tifluidsystems.com / investegate not fetchable here). Gross profit 396.8 is from aggregators (StockAnalysis, Stockopedia), not read on the RNS page. Distribution costs probably include outbound freight / warehousing, which CostVision charges in its logistics bucket - so the admin-only 4.1% is the lower bound for the overhead bucket, 7.7% the upper.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (SG&A less ALL adjusting items - estimate)
items.basis: Dowlais Group plc FY2024 statutory: revenue GBP 4,337m; cost of sales GBP 3,691m; gross profit GBP 646m; selling, general and administrative expenses GBP 813m (2024 comparative printed in the FY2025 results release); operating loss GBP 106m; adjusting items GBP 430m (adjusted operating profit 324). Statutory: 813 / 4,337 = 18.75% of revenue, 813 / 3,691 = 22.03% of cost of sales - inflated by acquisition-intangible amortisation, impairment and restructuring. IF all GBP 430m adjusting items sit in SG&A: (813 - 430) / 4,337 = 8.83% of revenue; 383 / 3,691 = 10.38% of cost of sales. The split of adjusting items between SG&A and other lines was not seen, so 10.38% is an estimate, not a reported figure.
items.kind: company annual results (statutory income statement; SG&A line from FY2025 release comparatives)
items.scope: GKN Automotive (driveline, ~GBP 3.9bn) + GKN Powder Metallurgy; group, all regions
items.notes: Revenue / cost of sales / gross profit also in https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dowlais-group--dwl/full-year-results-2024/8763479 and https://www.dowlais.com/files/investors/reports/2025/Dowlais-2024-ARA-interactive.pdf. Read from snippets only. Re-read the adjusting-items note before this is used: if part of the GBP 430m sits outside SG&A, the underlying ratio is higher.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (SG&A, median of 2 companies)
items.basis: Median (= mean of two) of TI Fluid Systems 7.68% and Dowlais (underlying, estimate) 10.38% = 9.03% of cost of sales; on revenue (6.77% + 8.83%) / 2 = 7.80%. Only two UK-listed suppliers found within budget; both are global groups, so this is a UK-HQ group ratio, not a UK-plant ratio.
items.scope: SG&A only. Plant overhead not in machine / labour rates (indirect staff, quality, site costs) sits INSIDE cost of sales and is not separable from these filings.
items.notes: CostVision applies 12% to material + process + labour + tooling (~ cost of sales). SG&A alone is 7.7-10.4% of cost of sales; 12% leaves ~2-4 points for plant overhead not in the rates. The evidence is consistent with 12% in order of magnitude but does not confirm it. ONS ABS (SIC 29) not reached.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (selling + administrative expenses)
items.basis: Huayu Automotive Systems (600741.SH) 2024 annual report: revenue CNY 168,852m (1688.52 yi); cost of sales 148,357m (1483.57 yi); selling expenses 735m (7.35 yi); administrative expenses 8,225m (82.25 yi); R&D 6,191m (61.91 yi). S+A = 7.35 + 82.25 = 89.60 yi. 89.60 / 1688.52 = 5.31% of revenue; 89.60 / 1483.57 = 6.04% of cost of sales. Including R&D: 151.51 / 1688.52 = 8.97% of revenue, 151.51 / 1483.57 = 10.21% of cost of sales.
items.scope: China's largest Tier-1 (SAIC group): interiors, chassis, electronics
items.notes: Chinese GAAP reports R&D as its own line since 2018 (not in administrative expenses). Read from snippets; one media source gave the selling-expense change as -36.52% v the report's -13.60% - the report's figure used. Selling expenses explicitly include logistics and packaging costs.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (selling + administrative expense ratios)
items.basis: Tuopu Group (601689.SH) 2024: revenue CNY 26.60bn; selling / administrative / R&D / finance expense ratios 1.0% / 2.3% / 4.6% / 0.6% of revenue (broker note on the 2024 annual report). S+A = 1.0 + 2.3 = 3.3% of revenue. Gross margin reported as 20.2% and 20.8% by two brokers, so cost of sales = 79.2-79.8% of revenue; 3.3 / 79.5 = 4.15% of cost of sales (range 4.14-4.17%).
items.kind: broker research note citing the annual report (ratios rounded to 0.1 pt)
items.scope: Chassis, NVH, thermal, body - Tesla / BYD supplier
items.notes: Ratios not read in the annual report itself (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-04-24/1223245403.PDF listed but not opened). Rounded ratios - +/-0.1 pt.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (selling + administrative expenses)
items.basis: Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls (002050.SZ) 2024 financial final-accounts report: revenue CNY 27,947.2m (2,794,716.45 wan); cost of sales ~20,270m; selling expenses ~726m; administrative expenses ~1,767m. S+A = 7.26 + 17.67 = 24.93 yi. 24.93 / 279.47 = 8.92% of revenue; 24.93 / 202.70 = 12.30% of cost of sales.
items.scope: Group: refrigeration controls (majority) + auto thermal-management parts - NOT pure automotive
items.notes: Snippet attributed the figures to Sanhua's 2024 final-accounts report; the exact URL among the result set is not certain. Mixed business lifts the ratio; treat as the high end.

items.unit: % of cost of sales (S+A, median of 3 companies)
items.basis: Median of Tuopu 4.15%, Huayu 6.04%, Sanhua 12.30% = 6.04% of cost of sales; on revenue median of 3.3%, 5.31%, 8.92% = 5.31%. Ratio to UK: 6.04 / 9.03 = 0.67 (cost-of-sales basis); 5.31 / 7.80 = 0.68 (revenue basis); against TI Fluid alone 6.04 / 7.68 = 0.79.
items.scope: SG&A only, ex-R&D (Chinese GAAP); plant overhead inside cost of sales not separable
items.notes: SUPPORTS the held multiplier 0.75 within the evidence range 0.67-0.79. UK filings may carry some R&D in admin while Chinese ones do not - a basis difference that would push the true ratio slightly up.

items.basis: Boryszew Group (WSE: BRS) consolidated H1 2024 half-year report: revenue PLN 2,655,766k; selling costs PLN 52,024k; general administrative costs PLN 153,141k. (52,024 + 153,141) / 2,655,766 = 7.73% of revenue. Cost of sales not seen, so no cost-of-sales ratio.

items.notes: Column headers garbled in the snippet; assignment to 2024 rests on revenue matching the reported H1 2024 PLN 2.656bn. One company, diversified, half year. PL/UK on revenue: 7.73 / 7.80 = 0.99 - does NOT support 0.85, but too weak (one diversified group) to move the multiplier.

notes: Every figure was read from search-result snippets: investegate.co.uk and sundram.com fail DNS here and other hosts were not fetchable, so every item is verify: true until read on the page.

Overhead basis: CostVision applies overhead to material + process + labour + tooling, which approximates COST OF SALES - so the % of cost of sales is the comparable figure. Annual reports separate SG&A only; plant overhead not in machine / labour rates is inside cost of sales and cannot be separated from these filings.

Multiplier verdicts: CN 0.75 SUPPORTED (evidence 0.67-0.79 v UK). IN 0.72 not testable (Ind-AS by-nature P&L). PL 0.85 not supported by its single datapoint (Boryszew ~0.99 of UK on revenue) but that datapoint is too weak to move it. HU 0.83 not testable.

Packaging verdicts: no like-for-like UK board price was found, so no carton ratio. Pallets: HU single-unit / UK single-unit = 0.53-0.63 (VAT basis of the UK price unknown) - BELOW the held 0.88, but pallets are one part of packaging GBP/part. CN 0.70 and IN 0.65: no admissible pallet price; China corrugating medium CNY 3,055/t (Oct 2026) is the only CN figure.
